knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A list makes every room get the same check, so no item is missed.
A shortfall is recorded and raised. An unapproved substitute or an item borrowed from another room is not used.
A line is ticked only after the item is in place and checked.

practicalCriteria: Restocks a simulated room from the list in layout order, checking presence, count, condition and expiry for each item.
Replaces a seeded expired item with approved stock and records the replacement.
Records a deliberate shortfall and does not substitute an item that is not on the approved list.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 percent pass mark (all three correct). Practical criteria are observed and signed off separately by an assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Completed restock list for the simulated room
Shortfall report with the item name and room
stopWorkCriteria: Expired or damaged consumable placed in a room
Item borrowed from another room without a record
